title: Investigating Associational Biases in Inter-Model Communication of Large Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying demographic distribution drift between male and female presentations during inter-model communication loops, analyzing spurious regional visual associations (e.g., relying on hair for emotion prediction) using Grad-CAM, and evaluating demographic parity in downstream prediction success rates.
Measuring distributional drift in perceived age categories (e.g., tracking a trend towards younger representations) across iterative image-to-text and text-to-image model exchanges.

Tracking shifts in the generated distribution of perceived ethnicities (Caucasian, African-American, Asian) and skin tones across continuous generative model feedback loops to identify systematic representation changes.
